deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: route=api/v1/generate version=v3.2.0 -> v3.3.0 rollout_window=30m initial_traffic=5% target_traffic=25% change-window=deploy-2026-03-20-13UTC 
maya: thanks, watching SLOs and logs. will flag anything obvious.
kevin: seeing p95 jump on api/v1/generate: ~160ms -> ~480ms over last 5m, and 429s up from 0.02% -> 0.6%. chart: https://dash.redwood/slo/api-v1-generate
sre-oncall: can you paste the prometheus query you used?
kevin: sure — pasted below
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/api/v1/generate",job="frontend"}[5m])) by (code)
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/api/v1/generate",job="frontend"}[5m]))
```
kevin: looks like client-side throttles (429) + backend p95 latency spike. logs show a flurry of kvcache misses for v3.3.0 nodes.
maya: quick A/B check: control (v3.2.0) p95 stable, candidate (v3.3.0) shows tail latency increase and more CPU fallback traces. could be new kv-prefetch flag.
devon: there was an opt-in kv-prefetch that slipped into v3.3.0 build by mistake (PR #1489). might be causing cache churn.
maya: recommendation: pin route to v3.2.0 100% while we triage — minimize user impact during change-window.
kevin: +1, let's pin. I'll run the pin command.
deploy-bot: Command received: `/deploy pin --route=api/v1/generate --version=v3.2.0 --duration=15m --reason="latency+429 spike during rollout"`
deploy-bot: Pin applied: route=api/v1/generate -> v3.2.0 (100%) by kevin at 2824030105 :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: muting alert policy for api/v1/generate error-rate for the pin window to avoid noise.
maya: grabbing heap profiles and KV cache heatmap from the affected hosts, will attach in ticket.
kevin: logs snippet from candidate node (v3.3.0):
```
[2026-03-20T13:12:03Z] warn kvcache: miss key=ctx_abc123, fallback_to_disk=true
[2026-03-20T13:12:03Z] error serve: quantize fallback triggered, path=/api/v1/generate latency_ms=312
```
devon: that matches the PR change — prefetch turned on but not gated behind the rollout flag. I'll open a rollback-pr (revert PR #1489) and a hotfix to gate it.
maya: plan: keep pin for 30m (extend from 15m) to collect traces and confirm rollback/hotfix. if hotfix <30m, we can rollforward; otherwise keep pinned and schedule full rollback of v3.3.0.
kevin: updating release notes and the release channel: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-20/v3.3.0 — add note about kv-prefetch regression.
sre-oncall: creating incident stub INC-4521 and linking logs/dashboards. will triage with eng.
deploy-bot: Pin duration updated: route=api/v1/generate duration=30m by maya at 2824030300
maya: thanks, everyone. I'll post findings in INC-4521 and update when heap + cache heatmap complete. :thumbsup:
kevin: if we need an immediate rollback plan, suggest rollback script: `/deploy rollback --version=v3.2.0 --route=api/v1/generate --force` ready in ops-runbook.
devon: working on revert PR now, ETA ~20m. will ping when ready.
maya: good. SLOs back to baseline after pin — monitoring for any residual 429s. will re-evaluate at 2824031700 and decide rollforward vs permanent rollback.
kevin: ack, putting a small note in the release notes and patch queue.
sre-oncall: keeping walkie on standby. notify if any other routes show similar pattern.
maya: closing loop for now — will update INC-4521 and release notes. :white_check_mark:
